integrity: Exact statements are supported by a written general proof and by an executable exact-rational finite check. Neither finite samples nor literature searches are presented as proofs of universal mathematical correctness or absolute publication novelty.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed generator with at most five states the positivity interval may depend on all transition rates.
The exact disconnected stochasticity set is for the stated six-state uniform pure-birth generator alone.
End-step nonnegativity is distinct from stagewise monotonicity and numerical rounding.
Publication priority is qualified by possible unindexed literature on conservative generators and subdiagonal Padé discretizations.
title: Six states are the sharp Radau IIA Markov positivity boundary
